repos_data.description: Git-first memory for AI agents: Markdown files are truth, the index is disposable, writes are reviewable commits.
Universal memory layer for AI agents. Remember, recall, consolidate.
🧠 Persistent memory for AI agents. SQLite for agent state. Zero cloud dependencies. Local embeddings. MCP-native integration with Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Windsurf & more.
Persistent, agent-agnostic session memory for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, opencode). One Markdown vault, any agent.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.
Memory engine for AI agents — time axis (3-layer decay/promotion) + space axis (self-organizing topic tree). Hybrid search, LLM consolidation. Single Rust binary.
Governed memory for long-lived coding agents. Trust, provenance, conflict detection. Local-first.
Long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents. Your own Obsidian vault as the source of truth. Daemonless and without opaque databases, your memory belongs to you.
Self-hosted MCP server for Obsidian: semantic + full-text search, wikilink graph, note CRUD, OAuth, and a self-describing vault guide.
Local-first AI memory you can see, edit, and override — portable across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP coding tools.
Long-term memory for AI-coded codebases. A git blame for AI agents — but for the why. MCP server that captures the agent's reasoning live, in context, as each change is made. Local SQLite, zero deps.
The #1 Obsidian MCP for AI memory — freshness-aware, cited, local-first and read-only by default. Dataview, Bases, PDFs, every agent.
